context.content_translation:
新工厂总监Ha-Jae Cheon将负责降低Tamarindo设施的维护成本。
A. fortunate
B. possible
C. senseless
D. responsible

items.question: The new plant director, Ha-Jae Cheon, will be ------- for reducing the maintenance costs at the Tamarindo facility.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“responsible”代入题干后为“The new plant director, Ha-Jae Cheon, will be responsible for reducing the maintenance costs at the Tamarindo facility.”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：D（responsible）。
